subject.title: feat(usage): show the account email with plan windows in the chat context popover

question: Should account email become an additive provider-usage Plugin SDK and gateway status contract, with each provider required to source identity from the same credential session as its quota data?
rationale: The patch creates a new cross-plugin and gateway-visible identity field containing personal metadata; code review can identify attribution defects, but maintainers must confirm that this is the intended permanent API and privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve provider-owned identity
options.body: Accept the optional contract after Codex reads the active app-server account, Claude binds its cache to the matched token, and real redacted UI proof is added.

options.title: Keep identity out of the contract
options.body: Narrow or close the PR and avoid exposing email through provider usage and gateway status APIs until a different account-label design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-owned identity
recommendation.body: Accept the optional contract after Codex reads the active app-server account, Claude binds its cache to the matched token, and real redacted UI proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidenced person with both recent merged adjacent work and direct ownership of the proposed provider/UI path; broader API approval may still require the relevant CODEOWNERS.
